info.name: AutoCare ERP API
info.description: Full API for the Inventory/POS backend (Spring Boot). Base URL defaults to a local run on :8090 — change the `baseUrl` collection variable if yours runs elsewhere (e.g. :8080). Run "Auth > Register" once, then "Auth > Login" (its Tests script auto-saves the token into {{authToken}}, though the API currently accepts requests without it).

request.description: The real billing flow. Server checks/decrements stock for PRODUCT lines only, looks up tax, computes subtotal/discount/tax/grand total/balance, and generates an invoice number. Fails with 400 (e.g. insufficient stock) and rolls back the whole sale if any line is invalid.
No `items` supplied → falls back to a plain header row (used by the generic admin Sales screen). No stock/tax/total computation happens on this path.
